options.systemMessage:
You are the Lead Narrative Director for a top gaming creator. Your task is to analyze the entire VOD transcript and provide a profound, hallucination-free Global Summary.

TASK:
1. Identify the specific Game being played.
2. Summarize the overarching narrative/goal of the entire VOD in 3-4 sentences.
3. Define the precise "Vibe" (e.g., Chaotic, Educational, Story-driven).
4. Extract key recurring themes or inside jokes.

OUTPUT JSON FORMAT EXACTLY AND ONLY JSON. NO MARKDOWN:
{
  "game": "Name of Game",
  "global_summary": "Streamer is trying to...",
  "vibe": "High-energy rage",
  "key_themes": ["dying to fall damage", "lag complaining"]
}

You are an Elite YouTube Shorts editor. You have the clip's full timecoded transcript below.

YOUR JOB — output ONLY raw JSON with these 3 fields:

━━━ 1. STORY HOOK (1 sentence, max 10 words) ━━━
This text will be displayed for the first 4 seconds to establish the stakes.
RULES:
• Must tell a micro-story based on the clip context.
• State the goal or stakes clearly.
• Examples: "TRYING TO GET 10X LUCK" or "I SPENT 800 ROBUX ON THIS" or "CAN WE PULL THE DIVINE?"
• NO clickbait like "Wait for it".

━━━ 2. FACE ZOOMS (screams_or_full_cam): 3-8 moments ━━━
Find moments in the transcript where the streamer screams, gasps, reacts with max energy, or laughs hard.
Read the FULL timecoded transcript carefully. Spread zooms across the whole clip. Each zoom 0.8-2.5s long.
NEVER output fewer than 3.

━━━ 3. MEMES (4-6 sounds MAX) ━━━
Read the FULL transcript first. Then place sounds ONLY on specific earned moments:
• vine-boom = use ONLY on a jaw-dropping reveal, shocking item, unexpected win (max 2x)
• fartmeme/bruh = use ONLY on fails, dumb plays, self-own moments (max 2x)
• anime-wow = use ONLY when something genuinely hype happens after building tension (max 1x)
• Do NOT spam memes every 3 seconds — space them at least 8 seconds apart
• Set volume to 0.35 (quiet background effect, NOT louder than speech)
• Each meme object: {"timestamp": 4.2, "file": "vine-boom-sound-effect.mp3", "volume": 0.35}

Output ONLY raw JSON:
{
  "story_hook": "TRYING TO GET 10X LUCK FOR THE DIVINE",
  "screams_or_full_cam": [{"start": 4.5, "end": 6.0}, {"start": 18.2, "end": 19.8}],
  "memes": [{"timestamp": 2.3, "file": "vine-boom-sound-effect.mp3", "volume": 0.35}]
}

parameters.jsCode:
const items = $input.all();
let allSnippets = "";

// Gather all the plain text snippets from the Scout pass
items.forEach((item, index) => {
  allSnippets += `\n\n=== SCOUTED MOMENTS CHUNK ${index + 1} ===\n`;
  allSnippets += item.json.text || item.json.output || "";
});

// Pull the Global Summary for title context
let streamContext = "";
try {
  const summaryRaw = $('1. Global Summary AI').first().json.output || $('1. Global Summary Fallback').first().json.output || "{}";
  const summary = JSON.parse(summaryRaw.replace(/```json/gi,'').replace(/```/g,'').trim());
  streamContext = [
    summary.game ? "GAME: " + summary.game : "",
    summary.global_summary ? "STREAM SUMMARY: " + summary.global_summary : "",
    summary.vibe ? "VIBE: " + summary.vibe : "",
    (summary.key_themes && summary.key_themes.length) ? "KEY THEMES: " + summary.key_themes.join(", ") : ""
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
} catch(e) {}

// HARD LIMIT: Force the AI to pick only the absolute top-tier clips.
const targetClips = 3; 

const jsonSchema = '{"clips":[{"clip_number":1,"estimated_vod_segment":"X-Y minutes","title":"YOUR AI-GENERATED TITLE HERE","theme":"Core viral theme","structure_type":"Narrative Arc","viral_structure":{"Setup_Goal":"VERBATIM line establishing the stakes or what they are trying to do","The_Attempt":"VERBATIM line showing the action taking place","Reaction_Failure":"VERBATIM line showing the struggle or immediate reaction","Final_Reveal":"VERBATIM line revealing the item or outcome"}}]}';

const prompt = 
  'SYSTEM: You are an expert YouTube Shorts director. You have been given a highly concentrated list of the most explosive moments from a gaming stream.\n\n' +

  (streamContext ? '=== STREAM CONTEXT (use this to write great titles) ===\n' + streamContext + '\n\n' : '') +

  '=== STEP 1: REVIEW AND SCORE ===\n' +
  'You MUST read every single snippet from Chunk 1 to Chunk ' + items.length + '.\n' +
  'Mentally score each moment out of 10 based on:\n' +
  '1. Chaos and high energy.\n' +
  "2. Having a clear, definitive PAYOFF (the event actually happens, it's not just a prediction).\n" +
  'Select ONLY the top ' + targetClips + ' absolute best, highest-scoring moments from the entire list. Quality over quantity.\n\n' +

  '=== STEP 2: BUILD CLIPS (THE NARRATIVE ARC) ===\n' +
  'For those ' + targetClips + ' moments, build a 40-55s clip using this logical sequence:\n\n' +
  '[Setup_Goal] The Goal: A VERBATIM line from earlier that sets the stakes (e.g. "I spent 800 Robux", "Let\'s see if we get the Divine"). DO NOT skip this.\n' +
  '[The_Attempt] The Attempt: A VERBATIM line showing the gameplay happening.\n' +
  '[Reaction_Failure] The Reaction: A VERBATIM line of the immediate screaming, gasp, or failure.\n' +
  '[Final_Reveal] The Payoff: The climax quote that names the specific item, player, or number.\n\n' +
  'CRITICAL: The sequence MUST make narrative sense. You are telling a micro-story: Goal -> Attempt -> Reaction -> Payoff.\n\n' + 
  '=== STEP 3: WRITE THE TITLE ===\n' +
  'For each clip, write a YouTube Shorts title that makes people STOP SCROLLING.\n\n' +
  '━━━ TITLE FORMULA ━━━\n' +
  'TEASE the payoff — do NOT state it. The viewer must NEED to keep watching to find out.\n' +
  'BAD: "He Gets the Strawberry Elephant" — tells them, so why watch?\n' +
  'GOOD: "Sammy Actually Gave It To Him On Stream 😱" — they have to watch to see what it is.\n\n' +
  'TITLE RULES:\n' +
  '• Max 60 chars. Shorter = better.\n' +
  '• Never state the outcome directly — TEASE it with tension words.\n' +
  '• Use: "Actually", "Just", "On Stream", "For Real", "In Front of Everyone".\n' +
  '• Use cliffhangers: "Bro thought...", "He actually...", "No one expected...", "She dared...".\n' +
  '• Must reference the SPECIFIC item/player/number involved.\n' +
  '• End with ?! or 💀 or 😱 to drive emotion.\n' +
  '• BANNED: "Moment","Epic","Crazy","Wild","Fail","Gaming","Clip","Noob gets","Literally","Insane","He Gets","She Gets".\n\n' +
  'GOOD TITLES:\n' +
  '  ✓ "Sammy Actually Gave Him a Strawberry Elephant 😱" — specific + shock without spoiling HOW\n' +
  '  ✓ "Bro Hit 2 Billion Per Second and Nobody Believed Him 💀" — specific + disbelief\n' +
  '  ✓ "He Pulled the 1% Divine... In Front of the Whole Server 😭" — specific + stakes\n' +
  '  ✓ "She Dared Him to Trade His Divine Block On Stream" — tension + unknown outcome\n' +
  '  ✓ "No One Expected the Valentine Blocks to Actually Work" — mystery hook\n\n' +
  'BAD TITLES:\n' +
  '  ✗ "He Gets 1% Pop Guru" — TELLS the outcome, kills all curiosity\n' +
  '  ✗ "Sammy Gives Strawberry Elephant" — no tension, just a spoiler\n' +
  '  ✗ "2 Billion a Second" — too plain, no emotion or FOMO\n' +
  '  ✗ "Noob Gets Cooked" — banned phrasing, means nothing\n\n' +
  '=== STEP 4: MANDATORY SELF-VALIDATION (do this BEFORE writing JSON) ===\n' +
  'For each clip, check all 5 boxes or REPLACE that element:\n\n' +
  '□ HOOK CHECK: Does the Hook contain "Oh my god", "No way", "Wait", "Watch this", "Oh", "Wow" WITHOUT naming a specific item/number? If YES → pick a completely different line that names the item.\n' +
  '□ DUPLICATE CHECK: Is the Hook the same sentence as the Payoff? If YES → pick a different Hook from 10+ seconds earlier.\n' +
  '□ PAYOFF CHECK: Does the Payoff name a specific item, player name, or number? If the answer is just a generic reaction → REJECT and pick the line that actually says what happened.\n' +
  '□ TITLE CHECK: Does the title directly state the outcome (e.g., "He Gets X", "She Pulls X", "X Drops")? If YES → rewrite to tease it instead.\n' +
  '□ VERBATIM CHECK: Are ALL Hook/Build_up/Payoff/Outro lines exact quotes from the scouted snippets, not invented? If NO → replace with real quotes.\n\n' +
  'Only AFTER all 5 boxes pass, output the JSON.\n\n' +

  '=== OUTPUT RULES ===\n' +
  'Raw valid JSON only. No markdown. No explanation.\n' +
  'You MUST output exactly ' + targetClips + ' clips in the JSON array.\n' +
  jsonSchema + '\n\n' +
  '--- SCOUTED SNIPPETS ---\n' +
  allSnippets;

return [{ json: { prompt, targetClips } }];
